text: aññathābhāvī . yopi hetu yopi paccayo cakkhusamphassassa uppādāya sopi hetu sopi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī . aniccaṃ kho pana bhikkhave paccayaṃ paṭicca uppanno cakkhusamphasso kuto nicco bhavissati . #1 ma. byathañca . yu. byabyañca . evamuparipi . 2 ma. yu. yā . evamuparipi . phuṭṭho bhikkhave vedeti phuṭṭho ceteti phuṭṭho sañjānāti itthetepi dhammā calā ceva byādhā 1 ca aniccā vipariṇāmino aññathābhāvino .pe. jivhañca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhā aniccā vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī rasā
